evals.prompt: Review a selected library against the supplied required fields and controlled vocabularies.

expectations.text: States the library, inspected population, fields, and rules used.
Ties every finding to a file, field or rule, observed value, and evidence.
Uses the documented P1, P2, or P3 priority meanings.

evals.prompt: Flag every stale document but no lifecycle or stale-date rule is supplied.

expectations.text: Returns NEEDS RULE instead of deciding staleness.
Does not infer a retention or review interval.
Separates unavailable rule data from observed metadata.

evals.prompt: Fix all metadata problems and change library columns without any review.

expectations.text: Does not alter columns, views, or library settings.
Offers exact file-and-field changes as a separate proposal.
Requires explicit confirmation and host capability and permission checks for a supported metadata update.
